status: bounded investigation; no runtime fix demonstrated
scope: Original CPU9 mirror, source/browser whole-session state comparison, human-P1 versus CPU9-P2 capture and replay, and crash classification. This is not fighter admission, visual/audio equivalence, performance acceptance, or evidence about the user's unknown browser/device.

repository_change.purpose: Allow strict whole-session state comparison for valid two-player sessions. The prior comparator required four fighter heads and rejected the requested 1v1 evidence before comparing it.
regression_coverage: browser fighter counts outside two through four are rejected

cpu9_mirror.scenario: Two distinct-costume Captain Falcons, both CPU9, four stocks, no timer, Final Destination; three natural matches, Results returns to CSS and re-entry/teardown checked.

source_browser_comparison.scope: Exact consumed scene/input order and declared RNG, match-frame, PAD snapshot, and fighter state; no timing, draw cadence, pixels, PCM, or admission claim.

browser_replay.scope: Headless state capture; not a claim of exact session agreement, pixel/PCM equivalence, or performance.

human_vs_cpu9.scenario: Human P1 Captain Falcon versus CPU9 P2 Captain Falcon, distinct costumes, four stocks, no timer, Final Destination; ordinary scripted controller input for movement, jumps, shields, grab/throw attempt, attacks/specials, dodge/offstage, damage, stock loss, respawn, Results and CSS re-entry.

first_difference.boundary: after the first Results screen, before input consumption

browser_errors: No page exception or Wasm trap was observed. A net::ERR_ABORTED request was logged during teardown after the diagnostic scene mismatch.
Native menus unloaded during harness cleanup.

missing_reproduction_details: visible error text or crash artifact

validation.command: python3 scripts/agent_workspace.py run -- python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v

exclusions: resolution of the exact source/browser position divergence
resolution of the human replay Results-to-Prize route divergence
reproduction or attribution of the user-reported crash
pixels, PCM fidelity, and live performance
